headline: Stonecradle and Expanse Renew Fighting, Godcrofts Quiets
war_summary: Since the midday edition the wires have shifted, with Stonecradle reporting five changes in the last two hours to 17:30 for twenty-eight on the day about The Heir's Knife, World's End and Trammel Pool at four Warden to five Colonial, while Stlican Shelf logged four in two hours to 17:30 for thirty-two on the day about Fort Hoarfrost, The Old Mourn and Thornhold still standing five Warden to four Colonial, and Weathered Expanse added four in two hours to 17:19 for twenty-nine on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk at four Warden to five Colonial. Deadlands has newly stirred with three changes in two hours to 17:56 about Callahan's Gate at one Warden to ten Colonial. Godcrofts, Fisherman's Row, Farranac Coast, Linn Mercy and Mooring County show no change in the last two hours after busy days, Godcrofts holding seventy-two changes to 14:43 about The Axehead and Fleecewatch for nine Colonial, Fisherman's Row thirty-nine to 13:15 about Arcadia and Eidolo for nine Colonial. Callahan's Passage remains quiet on the wires with three changes on the day despite 10,823 Colonial and 7,592 Warden losses in twenty-four hours with rates accelerating.
